author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh strawberries, delicate crepes, and the sweetness of summer in every bite 🌿🍓 In this video, we prepare soft homemade crepes filled with juicy strawberries, creating a simple yet irresistible seasonal treat.

The crepes are light, tender, and perfectly golden, while the fresh strawberries add natural sweetness and bright flavor. Served warm and fresh, they make a delightful breakfast, dessert, or afternoon snack.

This is simple summer cooking at its best — fresh ingredients, easy preparation, and timeless homemade flavor. A perfect way to enjoy the strawberry season and bring a little sweetness to your day. 🍓🥞☀️
title: Fresh Strawberry Crepes – A Perfect Summer Treat 🌿🍓
